measurement: Unmodified native timers, native mouse/CDP touch; timestamps are DOM commits, not exact command invocations. Pilot requests were marked just before dispatch; final baseline and correction requests were observed at actual pointer-event capture.

run_notes.baseline_pilot: Small exploratory characterization; misses are expected evidence of old P2.
run_notes.baseline_final: Both actual request positions captured. Characterization mode records misses without asserting success.
run_notes.correction_initial_classic: Two 390px groups failed before any gameplay because manual trace start conflicted with Playwright automatic tracing. Five other groups ran ten trials with both corners successful; retained below.
run_notes.correction_final: Playwright manages tracing. One worker, no retries, fresh contexts, no concurrent build or test workload. All 60 trials/120 two-cell turns passed.
